tickets.title: Process $38,000 gross IRA withdrawal for accessibility remodel
tickets.text: Process a $38,000 gross withdrawal from Dorian Pebblefizz’s traditional IRA at Velvet Acorn Custody and send it to Teacup Comet Bank checking for the first contractor deposit on the home accessibility remodel.
tickets.evidence: Dorian asked for a $38,000 gross distribution from the traditional IRA at Velvet Acorn Custody to be sent to Teacup Comet Bank checking for the first contractor deposit on the accessibility remodel. They agreed to process that withdrawal, with the follow-up dated 2025-08-15.

tickets.title: Adjust recurring IRA distribution to $6,500 gross per month
tickets.text: Raise Dorian Pebblefizz’s recurring traditional IRA distribution from $4,000 gross per month to $6,500 gross per month. Document the revised bank destination and withholding assumptions before the next payment cycle.
tickets.evidence: Dorian asked to raise the regular IRA cash flow from $4,000 gross per month to $6,500 gross per month and to document the revised bank destination and withholding assumptions before the next payment cycle. They agreed to make and document that adjustment, with the follow-up dated 2025-08-20.

tickets.title: Complete address and residency update workflow
tickets.text:
Use this workflow when a client reports a new mailing address, tax residency change, seasonal residence, or household relocation. Confirm the effective date, update advisory records, and identify planning consequences for tax-aware investment management, retirement income distributions, and account communications.

The Pebblefizz household moved from Portland, Oregon, to Henderson, Nevada, in June 2025 and now uses the Henderson home as its primary residence. Update advisory records, mailing information, meeting location notes, and retirement distribution withholding assumptions using the new residency facts Dorian provided.

subTasks.title: Confirm move details and documentation
subTasks.text: Collect the new mailing address, physical residence, prior address, effective date, seasonal residence notes, and any supporting documentation the client is comfortable providing.

subTasks.title: Update internal records and communication preferences
subTasks.text: Update CRM, household profile, statement delivery preferences, meeting location notes, and any compliance-required address fields.

subTasks.title: Review planning impacts
subTasks.text: Check whether the move affects state tax assumptions, retirement distribution withholding, municipal bond exposure, estate document jurisdiction, insurance coverage, or advisor registration requirements.

subTasks.title: Confirm completion with client
subTasks.text: Send a brief confirmation summarizing the updates made and any follow-up items the client should address with tax, legal, or account providers.

tickets.evidence: They agreed to complete those updates, with the follow-up dated 2025-08-22.

tickets.title: Address Oregon withholding discrepancy on recurring IRA distribution
tickets.text: Address the Oregon state withholding still shown on Dorian Pebblefizz’s recurring traditional IRA distribution at Velvet Acorn Custody. The Henderson home is the current primary residence, and Dorian does not expect Oregon withholding on future payments.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to address that discrepancy, with the follow-up dated 2025-08-29.

tickets.title: Check IRA ACH payment timing and bank instruction history
tickets.text: Check the payment timing and bank instruction history for the recent IRA ACH deposit that reached Teacup Comet Bank later than expected. Investigate the delay that led Dorian to move money manually from savings to cover household bills.
tickets.evidence: They agreed that the payment timing and bank instruction history need to be checked, with the follow-up dated 2025-08-18.

tickets.title: Year-End Deadline Sweep
tickets.text: Review the household’s higher IRA withdrawals, possible Portland sale proceeds, and Elena Pebblefizz’s expected 2025 wages of about $28,000 as inputs for a year-end cash flow and withholding review with Tobin Mossbutton of Amber Teapot Tax Services before final estimated tax planning.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to that review, with the follow-up dated 2025-11-14.

tickets.title: Request and organize estate document copies
tickets.text:
Ask Dorian Pebblefizz to provide current copies of core estate documents, including will, revocable trust if applicable, powers of attorney, health care directives, beneficiary designations, trustee or executor contact information, and any recent amendment pages. Store received documents according to firm procedures and note missing items for follow-up.

Dorian has only older estate papers available in the advisory file. Collect current wills, powers of attorney, trust amendment pages if applicable, and beneficiary confirmations for recordkeeping and planning review.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to collect those materials, with the follow-up dated 2025-09-05.

tickets.title: Review cash-raising options for concentrated employer stock
tickets.text: Review cash-raising options for the approximately $92,000 Paper Otter Components stock in the joint taxable account at Velvet Acorn Custody. Compare IRA distributions, taxable cash, and selective sales without assuming the employer stock is the first funding source. Account for Dorian’s preference to avoid selling the shares quickly unless tax impact and concentration risk are reviewed together.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to that cash-raising review, with the follow-up dated 2025-09-12.
